milestones.Manali: Start (2,050 m). Base town on the Beas river. The highway begins at Manali and climbs through pine forests toward the Rohtang tunnel.
milestones.Marhi: Last fuel / food stop before Rohtang. Snowplows queue here in winter. Reddit tip: top up fuel here — the next reliable fuel is Keylong.
milestones.Rohtang Pass: 3,978 m. Now bypassed by the Atal Tunnel (9 km, world's longest at altitude) which cut the pass crossing from 3+ hours to 15 min. The old pass road still exists for views. Reddit: "the Sarchu stretch is the most breathtaking in the entire trip."
milestones.Keylong: 3,080 m. District HQ of Lahaul & Spiti. First fuel/food after the pass. Army canteens sell cheap meals.
milestones.Darcha: Junction where the road to Zanskar branches off. Last village before the high-altitude desert stretch begins.
milestones.Baralacha La: 4,890 m. One of the highest motorable passes. Reddit: car engines noticeably lose power here; keep momentum on the climb.
milestones.Sarchu: Camping tents only — no permanent settlement. r/SoloTravel_India's 19,000 km epic rated this stretch "the most breathtaking in the entire trip."
milestones.Pang: 4,600 m. Permits required beyond here (Inner Line). Army canteen + basic camps. Night driving is banned in this sector.
milestones.Tanglang La: 5,328 m. The second-highest motorable pass in the world on a paved road. Winds can be brutal; Reddit riders say keep the car in 2nd gear on the descent.
milestones.Leh: Finish (3,524 m). Land of high passes. Acclimatize for 1-2 days before driving further. Fuel, permits (e-Permit for Nubra/Pangong), and mechanics all available here.
